import { OrderDto, toOrderDto } from '../dto/OrderDto';
import { OrderLookupService } from '../services/OrderLookupService';

export class GetOrderUseCase {
  constructor(private readonly lookup: OrderLookupService) {}

  execute(orderId: string): OrderDto {
    return toOrderDto(this.lookup.getById(orderId));
  }
}
